entities.name: On-Prem
entities.rationale: Server stack icon labelled ON-PREM at top left; source servers where Application Discovery and CloudEndure agents are installed. Outside the AWS accounts.

entities.name: Slack
entities.rationale: Slack logo labelled SLACK at top; the migration team issues a command from Slack that kicks off the migration factory.

entities.name: Migration Team
entities.rationale: Person icon labelled MIGRATION TEAM at top; they trigger Slack and fill DynamoDB with metadata.

entities.name: App Discovery Service
entities.rationale: Teal icon (AWS_Icon_6) labelled APP DISCOVERY SERVICE; left of the dashed line, in the source/migration account. Collects TCP connections and performance data from on-prem.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Purple icon (AWS_Icon_4) labelled DYNAMODB; left of the dashed line in the migration account. Stores operational metadata, tags, target account, subnet, IP.

entities.name: EC2 (Migration Factory)
entities.rationale: Orange icon (AWS_Icon_5) labelled EC2; left of the dashed line in the migration account. The migration factory instance that orchestrates all API calls.

entities.name: EC2 Hot Replica
entities.rationale: Orange icon (AWS_Icon_1) labelled EC2 HOT REPLICA; left of the dashed line in the migration account. Target of CloudEndure block-level replication from on-prem.

entities.name: CloudEndure
entities.rationale: Green logo labelled CLOUDENDURE; left of the dashed line. Live migration / volume replication service called by the migration factory.

entities.name: EC2 (Target Account)
entities.rationale: Orange icon (AWS_Icon_2) labelled EC2; right of the vertical dashed line, i.e. inside the target account. The final launched instance. BAKE AMI and SHARED AMI are drawn as grid icons but are disk images, so excluded as entities.

visual_connections.description: Arrow from the migration team to Slack; the team issues one command in Slack.
Arrow from the Slack / Migration Team area down into DynamoDB; the migration team fills DynamoDB with metadata.
Arrow from Slack down to the EC2 migration factory; Slack calls the API on the instance to start the migration.
Line from On-Prem going left and down into App Discovery Service; the discovery agent sends connection and performance metadata.
Long line from On-Prem down the left side into EC2 Hot Replica; block-by-block volume replication via the CloudEndure agent.
Arrow from the bottom of EC2 going left to App Discovery Service; API call to gather inbound/outbound TCP connections.
Arrow from the right of EC2 down to CloudEndure; API call to stop replication.
Arrow from CloudEndure left to EC2 Hot Replica; CloudEndure controls/stops replication on the hot replica.
Arrow from EC2 right and down to the BAKE AMI grid icon; the migration factory bakes the AMI (AMI is not an entity).
Arrow from EC2 crossing the dashed account boundary down to the SHARED AMI grid icon; AMI shared, encrypted, with the target account (AMI is not an entity).
Topmost arrow from EC2 crossing the dashed account boundary and down into the target-account EC2; the migration factory starts the instance with the sizing, IP and tags from DynamoDB.
